title: CAREER TOP RIGHT IN ONE ROW
why: His answer Q58 (10-18): career top right goes into one row. Credits and XP were one line and the stash and bag figures a second line under it.
now: In career the top right corner is one row: credits, XP, stash and bag side by side.

edits.anchor: #topright small:nth-last-child(2){ margin-right:0; }   /* v28.xx (cw-stashbag): the STASH and BAG line is the last child now */
edits.replacement: #topright small:nth-last-child(2){ margin-right:22px; }   /* v28.xx (cw-trrow), HIS ANSWER Q58 (2026-10-18): career top right goes into one row. The XP label is followed by the stash and bag figures on the same line now. */

edits.anchor: #topright .trsub{ position:absolute; right:0; top:40px; line-height:16px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--ash); }
edits.replacement: #topright .trsub{ position:static; display:inline; line-height:inherit; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--ash); }   /* v28.xx (cw-trrow): was a second line hanging under the readout (absolute, top 40px); now inline in the one row */
